newsitem.title: UK: Norbain shares crash after profits warning.
newsitem.headline: Norbain shares crash after profits warning.

text.p: UK video and security equipment group Norbain Plc said on Monday that profits for the year would be significantly below current market expectations.
It said in a statement that profits were unlikely to be materially different from the results for the year ended April 30, 1996, when it made pretax profits of 5.39 million stg.

Norbain said the decision by one of its major suppliers, Dedicated Micros Ltd, to stop supplying its products to Norbain from February 3 would have a negative impact on profits while it substituted products supplied by Dedicated.
Its shares were down 81-1/2p at 357-1/2p by 1315 GMT.
Norbain said that Dedicated Micros' products represented around eight percent of group sales in the current financial year.
The company also said it was trying to persuade Dedicated Micros to continue the arrangements and to maintain supply under what is effectively a binding contract.
